{{Quote|Remove pain and I serve Jedi loyally.|Unidentified Sith warrior|<ref name="A Mon Alone">{{LivingForce|A Mon Alone}}</ref>}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Sith warrior''' fought for the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] during the [[New Sith Wars]], and was bonded to the [[Sith battlelord]] [[Farh j'Hien]] via [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The warrior eventually defected from the Sith and became beset with pain as a result, due to his Force bond to j'Hien. Eventually, the warrior was captured by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kei Loo Bross]], and the warrior asked Bross to make his pain go away. Bross recorded an account of his encounter with the warrior, and the record was later included in the publication ''[[Speculations on Tactics of the Sith]]''.
